input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-source obligation is imposed on Sparkling (Customer). The only "exclusive" references are: a non-exclusive licence grant in Section 2 (a limit on the licence scope, not a purchasing covenant), the non-exclusive escrow licence at p0115, the exclusive-remedy provision in Section 15, and non-exclusive jurisdiction at p0146. The use restrictions in Section 3 are copying/assignment/reverse-engineering limits, and Sections 10-11 require Garman to supply maintenance and Sparkling to pay fees without requiring Sparkling to source software, maintenance or support solely from Garman. Searches for "sole", "requirements from", "competing", "solely from" and "other supplier" returned no exclusive-dealing language. Sparkling therefore retains freedom to buy from other suppliers, matching the preferred position; no redline needed.
